name: web-botanical-wellness-mobile-typography-screens
title: Botanical wellness site on mobile, sage gradient and giant caps
whatItIs: Three phones over a pale sage gradient. The screens are white with a tiny nav, huge light uppercase sentences with green highlighted words, an expert profile with a doctor photo, and a black pill CTA.
whatItMeans: Clinical yet natural; oversized light type gives authority while green keeps it botanical.
techniques: Highlight key words in a single green inside long uppercase statements.
Set text large and light so a whole paragraph reads like a poster on a phone.
Keep screens white with almost no chrome so the copy is the design.
Use a large cutout portrait with a black pill button for a strong end-of-page action.

vocabulary.definition: A long sentence set very large as the main graphic.
A word in accent colour inside black text.
Uppercase letters in a thin weight.
